contract.sync_assumed: harness group barrier between calls that reuse the temp storage and the output buffers
contract.sync_performed: internal synchronization as declared in the adapter header, measured inside the call
contract.header_contract: B2_packed with the block size as a tuning dimension (64 to 512 threads), packed key-index words, k fire-and-forget atomicMax rounds, blocked registers in, sorted indices to smem out, both requirements
contract.type_constraints: measured on bf16, fp32 keys with int32 indices
contract.nan_behavior: focus-set inputs contain no NaN, see the adapter header

correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 213 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | 130 cells dropped for lack of a control value (a cell-list batch run under the other requirement carries the same cells without the reference's path, their twins with a control are in the card), for example N1024 k4 bf16 prefer_smaller_index latency | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, 0.11, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094

low_level: Registers 18 to 255 over the 428 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (0 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 64 to 3088 bytes, harness 0.10, 0.11 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 20 to 1028 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 213 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 12 of 34 cells (runner-up in 0), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 12 of 34 cells (runner-up in 1), throughput not_guaranteed wins 9 of 34 cells (runner-up in 1), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 11 of 34 cells (runner-up in 3).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 1024, bf16 N 4096, bf16 N 8192, fp32 N 1024, fp32 N 4096, fp32 N 8192), the median margin over the runner-up is +14 percent and over the scope's reference control +109 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 8192 k 256 +1220 percent behind B4_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 8192 k 256 +1105 percent behind B4_v4 in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 4096 k 256 +979 percent behind B1_det2 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 256 +939 percent behind B1_idx@T512 in latency not_guaranteed.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 8 of 11 cells (runner-up in 0), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 8 of 11 cells (runner-up in 1), throughput not_guaranteed wins 2 of 11 cells (runner-up in 3), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 4 of 11 cells (runner-up in 4).

Shuffled tie-heavy input (harness 0.11, umbriel-b200-094): latency not_guaranteed wins 4 of 6 cells (runner-up in 0), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 4 of 6 cells (runner-up in 0), throughput not_guaranteed wins 2 of 6 cells (runner-up in 1), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 6 cells (runner-up in 1).
negative: The same kernel as B2_packed launched at 128 threads (the matrices report it as B2_packed@T128): its win region is small k at N 1024 to 8192, with the B1_reference control also instantiated at 128 threads in its cells.
surprises: At fp32 N 8192 k 16 the 128-thread form wins at 254 registers, a cell the N8 card recommended 256 threads for.
open_questions: Where the 128 against 256 thread crossover sits per key type when both are measured against the same control.

GB200 pass on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99 (WINNERS_gb200.md): the warp and sub-warp winners agree on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. The GB200 k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property).
